# Aston Pharma

> > Aston Pharma is a UK-based wholesale distributor of medical supplies, surgical sutures, healthcare PPE, cleaning equipment, and veterinary products for healthcare providers.

Aston Pharma specializes in supplying healthcare facilities, veterinary practices, and laboratories with a comprehensive range of products including Ethicon surgical sutures (VICRYL, MONOCRYL, PROLENE), infection control solutions from Clinell, Numatic cleaning equipment, and Butochem protective gloves. The company serves as a trusted UK medical distributor offering wholesale pricing and specialized product lines for professional healthcare environments.

## Key Topics

- Surgical Sutures (VICRYL, MONOCRYL, PROLENE, ETHIBOND)
- Ethicon Medical Products
- Healthcare PPE & Butochem Gloves
- Infection Control (Clinell)
- Numatic Cleaning Equipment
- Medical Supplies Wholesale
- Dental Supplies
- Veterinary Products
- Laboratory Equipment
- Healthcare Cleaning Solutions
- Medical Training Equipment
- Safety Footwear
- UK Medical Distribution
- Industrial Dry Vacuum Cleaners
- CleanCare Range
